title: Night-out UGC story
text: A talking-to-camera, phone-shot UGC style story that feels like a friend's recommendation
idea: UGC style: a presenter talks straight to the phone camera in a natural setting. The format feels like a friend's story, not an ad, which is why it holds attention.
why: Eye contact and a natural setting in the first second.
Phone-style framing that blends into the feed.
Easy to adapt to any product or offer.
